brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.evidence: Build contains exactly one piece: piece:0,0,0;half-s (Hex base · South half). No other piece cells exist. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: No neighbouring piece cells and no level 1 cells. Only modification is a drawer cut (drawer:0#0,0#cut) inside the base itself, not a beside/on-top cell.

Configurator currently offers only 1 drawer socket per single half base (find_sockets for drawer on half-s returned single slot 'n', half-n returned single slot 's', half-e/half-w and full returned 0). After adding one drawer, no further drawer sockets exist. Five independent drawers cannot be placed on a single base without adding beside/on-top cells to host notch/bay drawer frames, which would violate the 'nothing else added' constraint.

finish.summary: Single South half base with 1 drawer cut. Meets single-base and no-beside/on-top constraints, meshClash clear. Five-drawer requirement is unmet: live configurator limits a single hex base to max 1 integrated drawer socket; achieving five would require additional cells beside/on top for notch/bay frames, contradicting the brief.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
